CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #5
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Journey to Jerusalem True Discipleship? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Journey to Jerusalem True Discipleship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Journey to Jerusalem True Discipleship.
   C. Use Journey to Jerusalem True Discipleship to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Journey to Jerusalem True Discipleship has no place in daily life.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Methods of Studying the Holy Bible? (1 mark)

   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

8. Honesty means: (1 mark)
